checkpoints.summary: CP-HARDEN-07 design fixed from current wait evidence: replace release-reason workaround with explicit wait lifecycle states and resume signals.
decisions: WAITING_OWNER and WAITING_EXTERNAL are canonical lane statuses with active_claim=null.
enter_wait consumes a live implementation claim and preserves work_item, prior claim id, checkpoint/resume evidence and resource locks in wait_state.

hardening_backlog.title: Pre-commit canonical state mutation guard
hardening_backlog.problem: Direct API/main writes can place an invalid lane state on main before post-push validation catches it; one malformed lane can also make the global reconcile/validation workflow fail and leave the canonical projection stale.
hardening_backlog.target: Route worker/reviewer state transitions through an atomic validated mutation path or equivalent protected update gate, and isolate/quarantine invalid-lane projection failures so one lane cannot blind the whole control plane.
hardening_backlog.implementation: Transactional compare-and-swap inbox + per-lane projection incident isolation.

hardening_backlog.title: Resource-level conflict locks
hardening_backlog.problem: Duplicate protection uses exact work_item identity and separate lane files; simultaneous cross-lane claims or different work_item names can still overlap the same files/contracts/resources.
hardening_backlog.target: Add serialized claim authority plus explicit resource/scope lock keys with conflict detection while preserving safe parallel platform work.
hardening_backlog.implementation: Global namespaced resource locks on active claims, automatic branch locks, cross-lane conflict detection, canonical projection visibility, and transactional-inbox race rejection.

hardening_backlog.title: Unclaimed external-change ingress detection
hardening_backlog.problem: Repository work can merge without any canonical lane claim/checkpoint. PR #747 is a current example: roadmap captured it, workstream claim history did not.
hardening_backlog.target: Main/Reviewer detects relevant merged PRs/commits without a matching lane claim and requires reconciliation before treating them as canonical progress.

hardening_backlog.title: Canonical automation registry
hardening_backlog.problem: Scheduled mutating tasks can exist outside lane ownership or overreach their role. During this audit the automatic Reviewer continued the active main-reviewer hardening claim and produced PR #89 in parallel.
hardening_backlog.target: Register enabled mutating automations to lane ids and role capabilities; reject/flag unowned automation and forbid Reviewer takeover of active main-reviewer implementation claims.
hardening_backlog.implementation: Canonical automation-registry.json plus fail-closed mutation ingress authorization for actor identity, enabled state, write capability, allowed operation and target-lane ownership.

hardening_backlog.title: Roadmap dispatcher
hardening_backlog.problem: READY lanes still do not autonomously select and execute roadmap work; only specifically scheduled automations advance.
hardening_backlog.target: Complete AIR-10 bounded dispatcher with claim, checkpoint, reviewer and physical-gate semantics.

hardening_backlog.title: Evidence-backed canonical sync receipts
hardening_backlog.problem: canonical-sync-complete currently verifies referenced roadmap identifiers but does not cryptographically prove that the referenced roadmap content actually changed to match the accepted work.
hardening_backlog.target: Record before/after content digest or commit/ref evidence for every material roadmap synchronization before G7 can become PASS.

hardening_backlog.title: Machine-readable external/owner wait state
hardening_backlog.problem: A lane waiting only for physical-device or owner input can remain IMPLEMENTING with a live claim, producing false checkpoint-stale alerts and unnecessary lease heartbeats.
hardening_backlog.target: Represent external/owner waits explicitly without holding an implementation claim; preserve exact resume evidence and prevent the dispatcher from reacquiring the same blocked work until new input arrives.
